line.title: Place the 6thSTAR line under your review stars

steps.alt: Shopify admin, left panel, Online Store outlined

steps.say: On your live theme, click Edit theme.
steps.alt: The live theme card, Edit theme outlined

steps.say: At the top, open the page menu and choose Products › Default product.
steps.alt: The theme editor's page menu, Products, Default product outlined

steps.say: In the left panel, find Review stars.
steps.alt: The theme editor's left panel, Review stars outlined

steps.say: Point just below Review stars. Click the + that appears.
steps.alt: The + just below Review stars, outlined
The add-block panel, the Apps tab and 6thSTAR line outlined

steps.say: Check that the 6thSTAR line sits right under your stars. Click Save.
steps.alt: The preview with the 6thSTAR line under the stars, and Save, outlined

steps.say: Done. Back in 6thSTAR, this step shows ✓ and Turn on is ready.
steps.alt: The 6thSTAR Install step, Place the 6thSTAR line under your review stars, showing Done

help: Don't see Review stars? Your reviews app may need to add them first. Write to trosen@rosengroup.us.
Theme without app blocks? There's nothing to do. Your star still shows.
Moved it later? 6thSTAR will tell you, and this guide will open again.

ai.title: Share with AI shoppers

steps.say: Before you start: your store must be open to shoppers (no password) and qualify for Shopify Catalog. Check in Shopify
steps.alt: Shopify Catalog's status in Shopify, here Ineligible, outlined
steps.label: Before you start

steps.say: In Shopify, click Agentic. Under Sources, click Shopify Catalog's status.
steps.alt: Shopify admin, Agentic and Shopify Catalog's status outlined

steps.say: Click Review your product data. This opens Channel mapping.
steps.alt: Shopify Catalog's status panel, Review your product data outlined

steps.say: Click into Product description, then ⊕, to see its sources. 6thSTAR agent description is under Product metafields.
steps.alt: The Product description source list, 6thSTAR agent description outlined

steps.say: Take out Product description first, then add 6thSTAR agent description. Click Save.
steps.alt: Channel mapping with only 6thSTAR agent description left, and Save, outlined

steps.say: Done. Back in 6thSTAR, the AI shoppers card shows a green dot beside Through Shopify.
steps.alt: The 6thSTAR AI shoppers card, Through Shopify with a green dot, outlined

help: Shopify sends this to AI shoppers such as ChatGPT and Copilot. When each one reads it is up to them.
To undo it, set Product description back to your own description.
